findings.original_premise: TU-GR-1 requires grader/reference artifacts to be structurally unreachable from the agent, with a transcript path-leak tripwire. findings.revised_deliverable: First map the concrete evaluation process boundary and reuse 2a-iv’s host-enforced `bwrap`/namespace policy for grader process: keep rubric/gold files outside agent bind mounts/worktree, send submitted candidate bytes through a controlled pipe or immutable host-owned input, expose only the grader result. Add synthetic integration fixtures for denied path reads, transcript leak tripwire, tampered candidate/readset staleness, and failure/abstention refusing a pass. Inject mocked typed judge values; preserve deterministic gold labels and report model agreement separately from correctness. Do not run the local judge or claim deployed isolation in this zero-inference slice.

toolkit_reuse.what: Existing frozen gold rubric, per-criterion typed questions and explicit accuracy-vs-agreement distinction. Keep gold expected values host-only; do not pass them in the agent-visible catalogue.
Reuse typed constrained labels and explicit refusal/parse failures through mocked responses; failure is no verdict, never a default pass.
Freeze task/catalog/readset fingerprints and revalidate host authorization before judging; fingerprint detects stale inputs but does not secure filesystem access.
Optional later local-reader cost telemetry; fake primitives can test it offline, but it is neither filesystem isolation nor a grading warrant.
Existing bubblewrap/namespace hardening owner for the execution scorer; coordinate/reuse this implementation rather than duplicate sandbox plumbing.

source_evidence.observation: TU-GR-1 exact open boundary and adjacent observe-only solve-failure accounting; no inference is needed to implement the privacy tests.
Scorer isolation is explicitly delegated to 2a-iv, with unshare/bubblewrap and resource-boundary constraints; do not add an independent sandbox route.
Host-owned snapshot/revalidation/authorization API is available but only fingerprints the readset.
Frozen cases, typed outputs, and parse-failure path exist and can be used with injected mock responses.

findings.non_inference_scope: Owned fixture-only slice: fake judge response, temp agent/grader roots, mount/UID policy harness with synthetic secrets/gold, transcript scanner. No model calls, benchmark runs, inference, or deployment.
findings.inference_acceptance: Future use of a local typed judge remains local-only per operator ruling. Any quality/cost comparison is separate and cannot use confidence as correctness; deterministic expected labels or independent human truth remain authoritative.
findings.gate: Coordinate with scoring-infra 2a-iv owner before selecting shared sandbox code; no new operator approval for offline fixtures. Actual use on untrusted benchmark agents is gated on host isolation review.
